The manuals claim: the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH when the remote controller signal is lost and the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH. Incident reports are unverified accounts with no usable evidence in the approved collection. The main gap/conflict is whether Failsafe RTH auto-activates on RC loss (DJI claim) versus FAA guidance that emphasizes manual emergency procedures if the link cannot be reestablished.
